text: I tread water for exercise, sleeping on a bed of nails That gets me energized wherever I go Another sound boy dies, I feel like Jessica Fletcher It gets worse before it gets better Dear diary, people think I'm insane, cause I'm at the back of the pack When they run bulls in Spain, still I maintain Understand that I'm positive, so positive I negotiate freedom for hostages in countries like Afghanistan Diplomacy is useless, stop them in their tracks Show them that I am ruthless Come to stride, deliver, deliver, attack Please search the seven seas and wind up fishing
